currentCard.prompt: С правлением какого царя связана опричнина?

answers.note: Фёдор Иоаннович — последний царь из московской ветви Рюриковичей.
Опричнину учредил Иван IV в 1565 году, выделив особую территорию и аппарат власти.
Алексей Михайлович правил в 1645–1676 годах и был сыном Михаила Романова.
Михаил Романов был избран царём Земским собором в 1613 году.

currentCard.explanation: Опричнину ввёл Иван IV в 1565 году. Страну поделили на опричнину и земщину, а царь создал собственный двор со слугами и войском. Против бояр и политических противников применялись казни, ссылки и конфискации.

source.title: Родился первый русский царь Иван IV Васильевич | Президентская библиотека имени Б.Н. Ельцина

literal.prompt: С правлением какого царя связана опричнина?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The exact prompt asks which tsar’s reign is associated with the oprichnina. PRlib Ivan IV L50 explicitly says he introduced it in 1565, independently establishing key1. Fedor’s 1584 accession (Fedor L44), Mikhail’s 1613 election (Mikhail L45–48) and Alexey’s 1645 accession (Alexey L45) place the alternative reigns after that policy. All four are Russian tsars of comparable state-history context and identically governed genitive names; Fedor is an especially plausible adjacent-dynasty/successor confusion.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Опричнину ввёл Иван IV в 1565 году. Страну поделили на опричнину и земщину, а царь создал собственный двор со слугами и войском. Против бояр и политических противников применялись казни, ссылки и конфискации.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Sentence1 is directly supported by Ivan IV L50 (Ivan IV, introduction, 1565). Sentence2 accurately paraphrases the same paragraph’s division into oprichnina/zemshchina and separate court with servants and troops. Sentence3 paraphrases L52’s expressly named boyars/political opponents, executions, exile, confiscation. It avoids unsupported universal or numerical claims and names the correct answer directly.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Фёдор Иоаннович — последний царь из московской ветви Рюриковичей.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Fedor L44 establishes crowned-tsar status; L57 explicitly states that the Moscow branch of the Rurikid dynasty ended with him. “Последний царь из московской ветви” preserves that essential branch qualifier; the source’s broad page heading is not used to extend it to every Rurikid branch.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Опричнину учредил Иван IV в 1565 году, выделив особую территорию и аппарат власти.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Ivan IV L50 states the 1565 introduction, the territorial split and his separate court/servants/army; L51 describes the personal guard. The phrase “особую территорию и аппарат власти” is a compact supported description of those separate governing structures. The year and separate organization add concrete own-policy facts beyond the prompt’s association with the ruler.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Алексей Михайлович правил в 1645–1676 годах и был сыном Михаила Романова.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Alexey L45 explicitly gives his father Mikhail Fedorovich Romanov and accession in 1645; L60 dates his death to 1676, with the intervening biography consistently discussing his reign. Together they support both the 1645–1676 reign span and father/son relationship, without relying on another card’s matching note.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Михаил Романов был избран царём Земским собором в 1613 году.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Mikhail L45 explicitly describes the Zemsky Sobor’s election task, L46 the approval of Mikhail’s candidacy and L48 the formal election in 1613. This confirms the tsar/electing institution/year independently of the separate July coronation and of neighboring catalog questions.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: С правлением какого царя связана опричнина?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Фёдор Иоаннович — последний царь из московской ветви Рюриковичей.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: Фёдора Иоанновича agrees with “с правлением какого царя”; both names have the required genitive form. The note uses a complete nominative subject sentence.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: He is a Russian tsar and Ivan IV’s immediate successor/son in the primary biography, so confusion with the same dynasty and neighboring reign is plausible.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: Fedor’s coronation is 1584 (Fedor L44); the policy was introduced by Ivan IV in 1565 and abolished in 1572 (Ivan L50/L53). Thus Fedor is false for the policy/reign association, while key1 is independently established.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The Moscow-branch endpoint in Fedor L57 is a concrete fact specifically identifying this ruler, with the branch qualifier retained; it neither transfers Ivan’s policy to Fedor nor uses a negative placeholder.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: С правлением какого царя связана опричнина?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Опричнину учредил Иван IV в 1565 году, выделив особую территорию и аппарат власти.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: Ивана IV is the correct genitive construction after “с правлением”. The Roman numeral convention and note’s nominative Иван IV are standard and do not distinguish the key grammatically.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: A Russian tsar label of the same specificity as the alternatives; Roman numbering is conventional identification rather than a different answer category.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: Ivan L50 explicitly attributes introduction of the oprichnina to Ivan IV in 1565. This positive statement and the other rulers’ later reign contexts establish a single key without assuming the frozen index.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The 1565 year and separate territory/administration are useful details of Ivan’s own policy (L50–51), beyond merely repeating his name from prompt+key. The institutional paraphrase is justified by the described court, servants and army.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: С правлением какого царя связана опричнина?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Алексей Михайлович правил в 1645–1676 годах и был сыном Михаила Романова.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: Алексея Михайловича correctly completes the genitive ruler construction; the note has proper subject/verb agreement and unambiguous parentage.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: A Russian tsar associated with centralized personal government in his biography, giving a meaningful monarch-policy confusion while remaining chronologically distinguishable to a familiar player.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: Alexey acceded in 1645 (Alexey L45); the positive oprichnina origin statement is Ivan IV in 1565 (Ivan L50). His separate later institutions do not make his reign a second correct answer.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The note gives Alexey’s own reign dates and father. Both are expressly supported by accession/parentage L45 and death L60; nothing depends on a repeated note elsewhere in the catalog.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: С правлением какого царя связана опричнина?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Михаил Романов был избран царём Земским собором в 1613 году.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: Михаила Романова is consistently genitive after “с правлением”. The note’s subject and passive election phrase are normal Russian.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: A foundational Russian tsar near the dynastic transition; choosing among named tsars requires historical ruler-policy association rather than an absurd entity mismatch.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: Mikhail was elected in 1613 (Mikhail L45–48), after the oprichnina period expressly dated in Ivan L50/L53. The documented 1565 origin belongs uniquely to Ivan IV among these answers.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The note teaches the documented Zemsky Sobor election and year about Mikhail himself. This may coincide with a neighboring MAIN fact but is permitted own-option teaching; it is not a MAIN duplicate of this oprichnina question.

absoluteLevel.ground: The player must know the historical institution/policy term “опричнина” and attach it to a particular early-modern ruler. Mere recognition of Ivan as a tsar is insufficient; all four choices are actual Russian tsars, with Fedor a close dynastic successor and the two Romanovs meaningful state-policy alternatives. A reader familiar with Russian history likely knows the association; a general reader can narrow dynastic chronology but is not given an answer by grammar or category. No obscure date is required, so expert HARD is unwarranted. This is an editorial audience judgment, not telemetry or human acceptance.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: The oprichnina was instituted in 1565 with a separate territory and governing organization.
correctNoteExtraFact.beyondPromptKey: The prompt/key ask only the associated ruler; the note adds a year and the policy’s territorial/institutional form.
